description: Emitted to draw attention within one resource: to one of its annotations, or, with no annotation, to the resource as a whole. The resource is always named. resourceId is a guard, not navigation: a viewer currently showing a different resource ignores the event — a deliberate ignore rather than a silent no-op. Focus never moves the viewer; driving the Browser to a resource is browse:resource-open's job.

resourceId.description: Guard: the resource this focus applies to, always named. A viewer showing a different resource ignores the event. A focus with no annotation attends to this resource as a whole. Never causes navigation.
